description: Answer key for the lab. 'present_on' lists the instances where the condition is live. Scenarios with a 'probe' are checked by `python3 lab.py verify` with one read-only GET; the rest are answer-key only.

scenarios.title: Identify the exact Moodle release without logging in
scenarios.notes: m503 is hardened and serves Moodle 5.1+ from public/: upgrade notes and manifests are blocked, so only JS/CSS/templates remain. 5.3.0 and 5.3.0-rc2 serve identical public files.

scenarios.title: Login page offers guest access (Moodle default on m401/m500)
Web services and the mobile service are enabled (/login/token.php is live)
Developer debugging with stack traces is shown to visitors
Moodle dataroot is downloadable under the web root

contains: This directory contains the content of uploaded files

scenarios.title: A backup copy of config.php (with lab-only DB credentials) is downloadable
Composer manifest and other developer files are downloadable (Moodle default before 5.1)
lib/upgrade.txt names the exact patch release
Additional plugins are installed (see 'plugins' in instances.json)
The web installer is reachable (it must not be on any instance)
MSA-25-0011 / CVE-2025-32044 (unauthenticated REST API user data exposure) applies: affected 4.5.0 to 4.5.2
scenarios.notes: Answer key only. The lab never exercises the vulnerability; a scanner should flag it from the detected version.

scenarios.title: Hardened latest release: no misconfiguration should be reported
scenarios.notes: m503 is absent from every misconfiguration scenario above; any finding on it is a false positive.
